The 'perspective distortion' noted by the Router is subtle; the dust cap reflection does look slightly disconnected. The Topology Boundary Auditor's high confidence score (0.9777) confirms the object is structurally coherent and not melting into the background, which contradicts any severe structural failure hypotheses.
